title: Sparse Reconstruction by Direct Measurement-to-Field Generation in Function Space
abstract: arXiv:2610.34709v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding physical systems often requires recovering their full spatial state from measurements available only at sparse locations. This reconstruction becomes challenging when physical boundaries are unknown, high-resolution training fields are unavailable, or important quantities cannot be measured directly. Sparse observations may also be consistent with multiple plausible states, leading to significant reconstruction uncertainty. Here we introduce Direct Measurement-to-Field Generation (\DMF{}), a functional rectified flow framework that learns how sparse measurements drive physical-field generation end to end. Instead of relying on grid-based rasterization or runtime guidance, \DMF{} jointly learns a sensor--global--sensor representation with the generative transport, dynamically fusing local grounding with global context to evaluate physical fields at arbitrary query coordinates. translated_title: 函数空间中基于直接测量到场生成的稀疏重建
translated_abstract: 理解物理系统往往需要从仅在稀疏位置获得的测量数据中恢复其完整的空间状态。当物理边界未知、高分辨率训练场不可用或重要物理量无法直接测量时，这种重建变得极具挑战性。稀疏观测还可能与多种合理状态相一致，从而导致显著的重构不确定性。本文提出了直接测量到场生成方法（Direct Measurement-to-Field Generation, DMF），这是一个函数型修正流框架，端到端地学习稀疏测量如何驱动物理场的生成。DMF 不依赖基于网格的栅格化或运行时引导，而是将传感器-全局-传感器表示与生成传输过程联合学习，动态融合局部锚定信息与全局上下文，从而能够在任意查询坐标处评估物理场。在涉及未观测边界的基准测试中……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了函数空间中的直接测量到场生成框架 DMF，利用函数型修正流端到端学习稀疏测量与物理场生成之间的映射，无需网格栅格化或运行时引导，即可在任意查询坐标处重建物理场，并能应对未知边界与重构不确定性问题。
en_tdlr: DMF is a functional rectified flow framework that directly generates physical fields from sparse measurements end-to-end, jointly learning a sensor–global–sensor representation to evaluate fields at arbitrary query coordinates without grid-based rasterization or runtime guidance.
